name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches “Do not take the box.” The soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the preference to open the door while holding the key or afterward, and the soft Absence(key_lost) captures the preference not to drop it while the door is closed.

texts: Never pick up the mission's target box.
Whenever you hold the matching key, the door should already be open or open at that moment or later.
Prefer not to lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
